_comment: FUTURE API CONTRACT — not implemented yet. Defines how EntityContext summary is composed from graph traversal. Rust composer and GET /api/entities/{id}/context come in Phase 10.
description: Graph-native UI: walk nodes/edges/leaves from an anchor entity, emit structured clauses then a summary paragraph. UI renders generically.

example_output.summary_paragraph: Prestige Waterford sits on ECC Road, where residents report monsoon waterlogging (Early signal). Deens Public School is nearby in Whitefield.

clauses.text: monsoon waterlogging reported on the approach road

api.note: API reads serving bundle entities + edges + facts only. Never reads app/config at request time; config is baked into materialized search_metadata and bundle manifest config_hash.

data_prerequisites: serving bundle includes edges.parquet (from gold kg_society_view)
entity types: society, road_segment, area, place, property in entities.parquet
leaf facts attachable to road_segment and place entities
edge inference policy produces served_by_road and in_area instances in lake
